pages.title: The First Threshold
pages.text: We built the gates before we knew what stood outside.

pages.title: The Attendant
pages.text: He was appointed to count the guests. He has never stopped.

pages.title: A Borrowed Sky
pages.text: The stars return to their positions. The missing do not.

pages.title: An Empty Audience
pages.text: The curtain rose each night, though no living audience remained.

pages.title: The Applause
pages.text: Do not bow when you hear the applause. It is not for you.

pages.title: Your Reservation
pages.text: Your room was prepared long before you arrived.

pages.title: Still Water
pages.text: The garden remembers the faces we taught ourselves to forget.

pages.title: The Eighth Guest
pages.text: The attendant was not keeping us out. He was keeping the ceremony in.
